caption.text:
Sekuriti berinisial FH yang sempat terlibat cekcok dengan pengemudi Alphard di kawasan Bundaran HI, Jakarta Pusat, disebut mengalami intimidasi usai menegur mobil yang diduga menerobos lampu merah penyeberangan. Hal itu disampaikan kuasa hukum FH, Wiradarma Harefa.⁠
⁠
Menurut Wiradarma, setelah adu mulut di lokasi kejadian, FH dibawa ke pos polisi bersama tiga orang dari mobil Alphard. Di sana, FH disebut diminta melakukan push up. Karena baru menjalani operasi dan belum makan, FH menolak, lalu diminta melakukan gerakan seperti mengayuh sepeda dengan posisi telentang.⁠
⁠
"Lalu mereka mengancam melapor di tempat bekerja, biar dipecat, dikatain anj**g sampai FH ketakutan luar biasa, dengan terus menerus mengancam, intimidasi FH ketakutan luar biasa akhir minta maaf sampai sujud di hadapan mereka," kata Wiradarma.⁠
⁠
Kuasa hukum FH menyebut kliennya akhirnya sujud meminta maaf karena merasa sangat ketakutan. Dugaan intimidasi itu, termasuk informasi soal FH yang bersujud, kini masih didalami oleh pihak kepolisian.⁠
⁠
Kasubdit Gakkum Ditlantas Polda Metro Jaya AKBP Ojo Ruslani mengatakan seluruh informasi yang beredar masih dalam proses penelusuran. "Sedang ditelusuri," kata Ojo. Ia menambahkan, polisi juga akan mengklarifikasi informasi mengenai dugaan intimidasi dan aksi sujud tersebut.⁠
⁠
📸: Dok. Istimewa.⁠

caption.text_translation:
A security guard with initial FH who got involved in a fight with Alphard driver in Bundaran HI area, Central Jakarta, is said to be intimidated after trying to reprimand the car suspected of breaking the red light of the crossing. The matter was conveyed to the FH jurisdiction, Wiradarma Harefa.

According to Wiradarma, after a verbal fight at the scene, FH was taken to the police post with three people from Alphard's car. There, FH was called required to do push ups. Because he had just undergone surgery and had not eaten, FH refused, then was asked to do movements such as paddling a bicycle with an inverted position.

"Then they threatened to report at the workplace, let him be fired, said f**k until FH is extremely afraid, by continuously threatening, intimidating FH is incredibly afraid and finally apologizing until kneeling in front of them," said Wiradarma.

FH law enforcement said her client finally bowed down to apologize for feeling extremely scared. The allegations of intimidation, including information about a kneeling FH, are currently being investigated by police.

Kasubdit Gakkum Ditlantas Folda Metro Jaya AKBP Ojo Ruslani said all the information circulating is still under the search process. “Under investigation,” Ojo said. He added, the police will also clarify information regarding the alleged intimidation and prostitution.

 📸: Dok. Istimewa.
